property_summary: For any inputs, a correctly upgraded-contract check must find that C.proxiableUUID() returns the ERC-1967 IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT (0x360894...82bbc); the mutant returns ADMIN_SLOT instead, so the assertion that proxiableUUID() equals IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT fails on the mutant.
change_summary: Return the ADMIN_SLOT instead of the IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT so proxiableUUID() yields a different bytes32 value.
